title: Man Runs Through Hospital’s Glass Gate To Escape Cops
description:
On March 27th, 2023, officers responded to a report of a car crash. Upon arriving at the scene, they found no trace of the driver in the vehicle. However, he was later discovered walking down the street, approximately 100 feet from the crash site. The driver had knocked over several streetlights with his car. The man told the officers that he was a little disoriented and was heading to the hospital. However, the police found crushed amphetamine pills and drug paraphernalia in his car, as well as fake Louisiana ID cards. The man was taken to the hospital for a checkup. He suddenly became agitated and began refusing to be checked. He was taken to jail, but due to an elevated heartbeat and blood pressure, he was taken to the hospital again, where he did the unthinkable. One of the staff members asked the officer to remove the handcuffs so she could check the man’s vitals, but as soon as the officer did, the suspect ran off a few minutes later. The man sustained several lacerations after running through the glass. The man was charged with hit and run, possession of fake ID cards, Criminal Mischief 1000 Dollars or more, attempted escape from custody and possession of drugs.

The raw footage for the videos on this channel have been obtained directly from the respective Police Departments. We as a media company have the right to use it commercially. Most incidents may require a fee associated with the request and take several days to process.

The channel is not affiliated with any law enforcement agency.

Our channel is compliant with YouTube's Fair Use Policy as we create a storyline and cut down several hours of long footage to a few minutes to bring out the most entertaining and educational parts, just like other channels such as Code Blue Cam, Real World Police, Active Police Cam, Blue Watch and Bodycam FIles.

The featured content is NOT intended to publicly shame, ridicule, or degrade the individuals involved or to glorify violence in any way.
